rationale: Chess coaching requires elite focus and precision. The Performance Pro archetype provides a command-center aesthetic, utilizing tactical minimalism and high contrast to help users analyze games efficiently without distraction.

typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter on all headings above 32px. Use Chivo for all numeric data (accuracy, score) to give it weight.

spacing_and_layout.global_rule: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding of p-6 or p-8. Use generous spacing between sections.
spacing_and_layout.page_structure: Left panel (Board + Controls): 55% width. Right panel (Tabs content): 45% width. Decrypt tab must override to full width (100%) for cinematic immersion.

grid_modes.coach_and_habits: MODE B: The 'Control Room' Grid. Dense. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 with gap-4 or gap-6.
grid_modes.decrypt_landing: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical hero spanning 12 cols with gap-8.

components.cards: Cardless feel or strict max 8px border-radius (rounded-sm). Flat solid backgrounds with 1px border-border/40. No soft drop shadows. Rely on 1px solid strokes or 2px inner glow highlights for emphasis.
components.buttons: Primary CTA uses Volt Blue (#007AFF) background with pure white text. Secondary actions use transparent backgrounds with borders. Focus states must have higher contrast (e.g., ring-2 ring-blue-300).
components.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' strictly for sticky headers or bottom action bars (e.g., 'I understand' panel in Decrypt). backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with a subtle border-white/10 top border.
components.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with Duotone or Bold weights for clear, tactical legibility.
components.charts: Use Shadcn/Recharts for 'Track' and 'Chess DNA'. Limit gridlines to improve clarity. Use Emerald and Volt Blue for data lines.

interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements must translate-y-[-2px] with an increased border brightness and explicit text color change.
interactions.animations: Subtle entrance animations for Habit checklist. Smooth transitions (0.2s ease) on transforms and opacities.
interactions.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based (e.g., 'board-next-move-button', 'coach-tab-trigger').

images.description: Abstract tactical grid background for the Decrypt tab immersive landing page.
Dramatic dark slate texture for the Coach tab summary banner.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. Render overlay opacity at bg-black/40 over hero images.

specific_page_instructions.global_header: Show Opponent vs You with Won/Lost badge. Accuracy % should be dominant, using a circular progress ring.
specific_page_instructions.board_area: Render board left 55%. Place Neumorphic playback controls (prev/next/play) directly beneath.
specific_page_instructions.coach_tab: Split into Diagnose, Drill, Track. 'Diagnose' lists blunders in Red. 'Drill' presents an interactive challenge. 'Track' displays trend charts.
specific_page_instructions.habits_tab: Pass/fail checklist using Phosphor CheckCircle (Emerald) and XCircle (Red). Include a Chess DNA radar chart or stats block.
specific_page_instructions.decrypt_tab: Landing state is a cinematic full-width hero with 'decrypt_hero_bg'. Clicking 'Start' expands to a move-by-move coaching session with an AI explanation box. The 'I understand' button must be primary (Volt Blue).
